recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration formalize the cash write- off process and provide guidance to the entities concerned to ensure that cash losses are recognized in the financial statements within the financial year of the loss, regardless of the status of the investigation, in accordance with IPSAS 1 and IPSAS 19. In the case that an investigation remains in process, this shall be disclosed in the schedule of write-offs sent in accordance with financial regulation 6.5.
